== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-tantiveiv-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Tantive IV (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (by 17 August 2019): Same game text. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in place of the bronze disc. The type line reads “CAPITAL: CORELLIAN CORVETTE” again, with the stat box “ARMOR 4”.

The whole earlier image and the whole new image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
